test_title: PYST 69: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

X + Y means ‘X is the sister of Y’,

X − Y means ‘X is the wife of Y’,

X × Y means ‘X is the mother of Y’,

X ÷ Y means ‘X is the father of Y’.

Based on the above, how is H related to L if ‘H × I − J ÷ K + L’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 X is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 –
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Wife
 Mother

 to Y
 
 

Given: H × I − J ÷ K + L

H × I → H is the mother of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c7b1eccc70aa7eb9111d05c6dc6d78e6d3bca7c474ee9461992d7b094a5006f.png] 

I − J → I is the wife of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd16ac7833a7eb426592d77112cb6f4936983e660f6d767cad4b2c5e8f14d5c8.png] 

J ÷ K → J is the father of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1282d8b2978c75b0d9bdbdc9d0d5a2403597c1c3296a0898abbfa2d8a19fe1c4.png] 

K + L → K is the sister of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4e45b53c12c5a6c617cf90b61c089bfd79aaa19cdde9df6047b02b40b0777e0.png] 

Thus, H is L's mother’s mother or maternal grandmother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
